slides.etiqueta: Insulin sensitivity: what nobody explains to you after 30

slides.texto:
Insulin moves glucose into your cells.
When your cells stop responding, your body pumps out more and more insulin. That's insulin resistance.

Growing belly, sleepy after meals, hungry every 2 hours and afternoon crashes.
It's not your age. It may be your metabolism.

It's diagnosed with 3 of these 5: large waist, high glucose, high triglycerides, high blood pressure and low HDL.
Many men over 30 have it and don't know.

Muscle is your biggest glucose storage.
More muscle and more movement = better insulin sensitivity. Strength + walking after meals + good sleep.

slides.etiqueta: What to check in your bloodwork
slides.texto:
Ask your doctor for: fasting glucose, HbA1c, fasting insulin, triglycerides and HDL.
And measure your waist. What isn't measured isn't improved.
